verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships its own MCP server. Through it, an agent host can read and change collections, requests, environments, and teams, and send real HTTP requests, so the product can be driven by natural-language instructions given to an external agent. Its built-in AI features cover narrower assistive tasks: renaming requests, generating payloads, and writing pre-request scripts and tests. There is no documented native natural-language command interface inside the app, and nothing hands-on confirms how well agent-driven operation works. missing for 10: built-in natural-language command bar or chat in the product, documentation of which actions natural-language/MCP operation covers end-to-end, independent or hands-on corroboration.
